label: Over-the-shoulder
camera_rules: Keep the camera outside the aligned character with a readable shoulder, head edge, hand, or body mass in foreground.
Maintain the aligned character as the attention anchor while keeping the facing subject readable.
Use foreground occlusion deliberately and preserve limb ownership.
continuity_rules: Preserve eyeline height and target across reverse coverage.
Keep foreground anatomy attached to the aligned character.
Carry prop ownership and contact geometry through the cut.
knowledge_policy: Apply the declared focalization and do not reveal information outside its scope unless the shot plan records a deliberate change.
